about: Pending US public-company acquisitions. Terms come only from SEC filings and the companies' press releases. verified is true only where the number or date was read in the linked source; anything else is marked Unverified with a note. Pending means no completion (Item 2.01) or termination (Item 1.02) 8-K was found on EDGAR as of as_of. Not investment advice.
close_date_rule: When a filing states a period instead of a date, by_date is the last day of that period (for example first half of 2027 is 2027-06-30).
unaffected_rule: Target close on the trading day before the announcement date.
disclaimer: Not investment advice. Spreads and the implied chance are mechanical arithmetic on public prices and filed terms, not forecasts or recommendations. Prices can be delayed or wrong.
